name: AgentDrives
description: Look up whether an AI agent can really use a software product before it picks one. AgentDrives drives SaaS, API, MCP and CLI products with a real agent (sign-up, API key, the core tasks, paying, leaving) and gives each a level from 0 to 5 with the date of the drive and where the agent stopped. Tools find the products for a task, search the directory, read one product's result and agent surfaces, compare products, and list categories, leaders and recent changes. Read-only, no account or key.
author: AgentDrives
